svg.title: Silo Agent system design: Send a chat message
svg.desc: Silo Agent architecture with the "Send a chat message" flow playing through it, 15 steps through 6 parts.
svg.text: Silo Agent · Send a chat message

g.text: STEP 1 OF 15 · REQUEST · WEB CONSOLE → CONTROL PLANE
Own the Bot and chat; writable?
ownBot/ownChat scope to the signed-in user; automation and subagent logs are read-only.
STEP 3 OF 15 · REQUEST · CONTROL PLANE → POSTGRES
The New chat page makes the row with this message; a refused send deletes it again.
One live run per conversation; a message during a run is injected into its inbox instead.
STEP 5 OF 15 · REQUEST · CONTROL PLANE → POSTGRES
STEP 6 OF 15 · REQUEST · CONTROL PLANE → CONTAINER ENGINE
Always confirms the box with the engine even with a live worker session; creates it on the Bot's own egress network…
STEP 7 OF 15 · REQUEST · CONTROL PLANE → POSTGRES
History is rebuilt byte for byte from the log so the provider's prompt cache keeps hitting.
STEP 8 OF 15 · REQUEST · CONTROL PLANE → MODEL PROVIDERS
System prompt built once per run in cache tiers; thinking level fitted to the model.
STEP 9 OF 15 · REPLY · MODEL PROVIDERS → CONTROL PLANE
Every tool goes through one engine: surface check, the rule (Allow/Auto/Ask/Deny), then the handler.
STEP 11 OF 15 · REQUEST · CONTROL PLANE → BOT BOX
Queued on the worker's Commands stream; the run's first file-changing tool takes a Changes snapshot first.
STEP 12 OF 15 · REPLY · BOT BOX → CONTROL PLANE
Chunks stream to the thread live; done resolves the waiting call with masked output.
STEP 13 OF 15 · REQUEST · CONTROL PLANE → POSTGRES
Output is filtered, masked and capped at 12000 bytes before the model or the log sees it.
STEP 14 OF 15 · REQUEST · CONTROL PLANE → MODEL PROVIDERS
STEP 15 OF 15 · REPLY · CONTROL PLANE → WEB CONSOLE
The client replays persisted events and reconnects with after_event_id.
SEND A CHAT MESSAGE · 15 STEPS THROUGH 6 PARTS
One run per chat: stream model turns, run tools on the Bot's box.
Every hop is read from the code: the dot is the request; faded parts take no part in this flow.
